additional_info.subject: 0444780 - ID0444780/DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002442]CU logs check CRM:00314000224
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0444780.
The ticket was opened for issues to authenticate via RFID on 19.08.2025 on charger
MP/R9 170002442.
I checked the logs at the timestamp provided, and these are the results of my analysis:
First time user authenticated with RFID at 2025-08-19T12:25:49. IdTag "05A4F890" Blocked
Second time at 2025-08-19T12:26:03 with same IdTag:
User plugged in the car twice, without authenticating
At 2025-08-19T12:35:56 he authorized via App, and it was accepted. However, the car was already plugged in, so he plugged out and plugged in. This is a wrong behavior, because in the moment he plugged out he should have authenticated again.
At 2025-08-19T12:49:31 he tried to authenticate again with the same blocked RFID:
At 2025-08-19T12:51:5 he finally succeeded to charge, as he first authenticated via APP with RemoteStartTransaction, and then he plugged in the EV.
The issue of the failed attempts to authenticate was the IdTag blocked and a misbehavior in the authentication phase.
If there are no further question or information required, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon.
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: 0444780 - ID0444780/DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002442]CU logs check CRM:00314000224
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
RFID blocked could mean that the RFID IdTag is not registered in the authorization list of the Backend, that the IdTag is blocked by the Backend, that the IdTag expired or else.
From Siemens HQ I cannot say what is the reason for this. The user should contact the provider and understand why his RFID is not accepted.
The issue is there between the user and the Backend/service provider.
Since there are no further open point pending, I will proceed to close this ticket!
